description: Current league standing. Sourced from standings snapshot; not derived from match legs.
Total points earned in the form window: 3 per win, 1 per draw, 0 per loss.
numerator: 3 if W / 1 if D / 0 if L

description: Average goals scored per match in the form window.
Average goals conceded per match in the form window.
Matches with zero goals conceded in the window, shown as a count of games played (e.g. 3/5).
Average total shots attempted per match with available team stats in the window. Includes on-target, off-target and blocked shots.
Share of shots that were on target. Total shots include blocked shots. Null when shots_total is zero.
Share of shots taken from inside the penalty area. Null when shots_total is zero.
Average shots on target per match with available shots-on-target stats in the window (its own coverage count — same-window rule).

Goals per shot on target, over matches with shot stats available (numerator and denominator share the window). Can exceed 100% when a goal is not counted as a shot on target (penalties, own goals in the team's favour) — shown uncapped. Null when shots_on_goal is zero.
Average duels contested per match. Aggregated from player stats; inherits player-stat coverage gaps. Volume context for the duel win rate.
Duel win rate in the form window. Null when duels_total is zero. Aggregated from player stats.
Dribble success rate in the form window. Null when dribbles_attempts is zero. Aggregated from player stats.
Average defensive actions per match: tackles + interceptions + blocks. Aggregated from player stats; inherits player-stat coverage gaps. Displayed with the T/I/B breakdown.
Average tackles per match. Aggregated from player stats; inherits player-stat coverage gaps.
Average interceptions per match. Aggregated from player stats; inherits player-stat coverage gaps.
Average shots blocked per match. Aggregated from player stats; inherits player-stat coverage gaps.
Average passes attempted per match with available team stats in the window.
Share of passes successfully completed. Null when passes_total is zero.
Average key passes per match. Aggregated from player stats; inherits player-stat coverage gaps.
Average corner kicks won per match with available team stats in the window.
Average corner kicks conceded per match with available opponent stats in the window.
Share of shots on target faced that were saved. Self-bounding denominator (saves + goals conceded in save-covered games). Null when no save-covered games.
